components.name: Static Site Build Pipeline
components.responsibility: Render templates and source data into the deployable site via scripts/build.py, failing closed when Python/Jinja dependencies are unavailable.

components.name: Public Link Integrity Checker
components.responsibility: Validate that public links and assets resolve via scripts/check-public-links.py before/after build.

components.name: Cloudflare Worker Edge Router
components.responsibility: Serve as the deployed worker entrypoint (worker/index.js) routing inbound requests and delegating agent traffic to the MCP server module.

components.name: MCP Server Module
components.responsibility: Implement the Model Context Protocol surface (worker/mcp/server.js) that exposes agent-facing tools/resources.

components.name: Public Agent Data & Discovery Metadata
components.responsibility: Provide machine-readable profile and agent discovery metadata as committed source (api/v1/profile.json, llms.txt).

components.name: Persona Representation Corpus
components.responsibility: Author the source-of-truth narrative for how AI agents represent Leon Breukelman across positioning, voice, strengths, stories, data sources, and contact (prompt/represent_me.md).

components.name: Project Documentation
components.responsibility: Onboard humans and AI agents with install, development, build, preview, deployment, and structure guidance (README.md).

contracts.name: Worker edge router invokes MCP server module
Build pipeline consumes public agent data
Build pipeline renders persona corpus into site
Link checker validates public data and docs links

cross_cutting_concerns.description: Every component, contract, and check must trace to selected nodes and prov identifiers in the packet; no files, edges, or behaviors are invented beyond the supplied graph.
The build must be reproducible; scripts/build.py imports datetime, which can inject nondeterministic timestamps into rendered output and must be pinned or excluded from acceptance comparisons.
cross_cutting_concerns.triggered_by: scripts/build.py imports datetime via edge:9b853eb4121c2243cd48, risking nondeterministic build output

cross_cutting_concerns.description: Each emitted component and contract carries prov references back to its source node(s) so the decomposition is auditable against the repository.
The acceptance command must not invoke any live paid API; npm run build performs local rendering and npm run check:links performs unauthenticated public HTTP fetches only.

goal: decompose the AI-first public site and agent metadata project into source-backed components across build scripts, JavaScript worker code, public JSON data, templates, and docs

near_neighbor_alternatives.alternative: Own the generated dist/ output as the primary build artifact component.
near_neighbor_alternatives.why_not_primary: Non-goal forbids treating generated dist output as source ownership; scripts/build.py is the source-of-truth build surface.

near_neighbor_alternatives.alternative: Run the MCP server as a standalone Node process instead of a Cloudflare Worker module.
near_neighbor_alternatives.why_not_primary: Source shows worker/mcp/server.js imported by the Cloudflare worker entry (worker/index.js) and deployment targets Cloudflare Pages; the packet does not require an alternate runtime.

near_neighbor_alternatives.alternative: Generate api/v1/profile.json and llms.txt at build time rather than committing them as source.
near_neighbor_alternatives.why_not_primary: The packet selects profile.json (config) and llms.txt as committed source files with their own prov, and no edge shows build.py emitting them.

near_neighbor_alternatives.alternative: Fold the represent_me persona prompt into the public JSON data component.
near_neighbor_alternatives.why_not_primary: prompt/represent_me.md is a distinct prose corpus (file plus nine narrative sections) with separate prov; it is authored representation guidance, not machine-readable API data.

non_goals: do not treat generated dist output as source ownership
do not require Cloudflare deployment or public mutation

observable_checks.command: npm run build && npm run check:links
observable_checks.description: Canonical project verification: build the static site and validate that all public links resolve.
Build the site only, exercising template/data/persona rendering; fails closed if Python/Jinja dependencies are unavailable.
Validate public links and assets resolve over the network without paid API access.

verification_gaps.description: build.py's consumption of api/v1/profile.json, llms.txt, and the persona corpus is not represented by any graph edge; only Python stdlib/jinja2 import edges were captured, so the build-consumes-data and build-renders-persona contracts are inferred rather than graph-observed.
verification_gaps.proposed_closure_check: Assert that rendered build output embeds fields from api/v1/profile.json and headings from prompt/represent_me.md after npm run build.

verification_gaps.description: build.py imports jinja2 and README#Structure documents a templates surface, but no template node was selected in the packet, leaving the template surface uncomponentized.
verification_gaps.proposed_closure_check: Re-run graph extraction to include template (e.g. *.j2/*.html) nodes and bind them to the build pipeline component, then verify each template is rendered by npm run build.

verification_gaps.description: scripts/check-public-links.py uses urllib.request to fetch public URLs, but the set of checked targets is not represented as graph nodes/edges, so link-surface coverage cannot be verified from the packet.
verification_gaps.proposed_closure_check: Capture the link inventory emitted by npm run check:links and assert each public asset (api/v1/profile.json, llms.txt) is included in the checked set.

verification_gaps.description: The MCP request/response contract served by worker/mcp/server.js is not captured by any node/edge beyond the module import, so the protocol surface is unverified.
verification_gaps.proposed_closure_check: Add a worker integration test that issues a representative MCP request through worker/index.js and asserts a schema-valid response from the server module.
